title: Agent swarms and the new model economics
summary: This article explores how AI agent swarms (multiple autonomous agents collaborating) are reshaping the economics of AI model deployment, discussing cost efficiency, scalability patterns, and the trade-offs between using multiple smaller models versus single large models for complex tasks.
problem_solved: How to optimize the cost-performance balance when deploying multiple AI agents that need to collaborate on complex tasks.
why_valuable: It provides practical insights into the emerging architectural patterns for building scalable, cost-effective multi-agent AI systems in production environments.
